profiles.name: Industrial Workshop
profiles.description: Humming machinery, harsh functional lighting, and utilitarian benches. Maximizes workshop output at the expense of quiet morale.

profiles.name: Sterile Infirmary
profiles.description: Disinfected surfaces, white glare, and austere organization. Improves sanitary task efficiency but creates an clinical, tense ambiance.

profiles.name: Lived-In Quarters
profiles.description: Worn rugs, shared tables, personal trinkets, and steady shelter rhythm. A balanced baseline offering mild comfort and familiar companionship.

profiles.name: Warm Sanctuary
profiles.description: Soft amber lamps, insulated partitions, communal hearth, and high decoration. Greatly lifts spirits and speeds psychological recovery.

profiles.name: Freezing Draft
profiles.description: Flickering emergency bulbs, biting drafts, and dim freezing corners. Drains survivor resolve and slows physical labor.

profiles.name: Chaotic Commons
profiles.description: Echoing clamor, overcrowded corridors, and clattering salvage. Disorganizes routines and causes severe cognitive strain.

profiles.name: Serene Refuge
profiles.description: Whisper-quiet acoustic dampening, scrubbed fresh airflow, and restful lighting. Maximizes stress relief and mental solace.
